Gjoa v0.4.5 concentrates on address-bar interaction, tab dragging, and compact-layout reliability.

## Highlights

- Introduced a larger, centered Ctrl+L palette with a compact keyboard-hint footer.
- Kept the palette in the top layer and preserved its row height, caret, focus, and paint through startup, fullscreen, modal dialogs, hot reloads, and orientation changes.
- Fixed dragging tabs into an empty pinned section, onto its divider, or through child elements; the drop indicator no longer intercepts its own drop.
- Unified collapsed-rail spacing and refined the horizontal layout menu and strip-hiding affordance.
- Prevented native toolbar springs from over-expanding compact and horizontal layouts.
- Repaired release preflight compatibility with the pinned Beagle compiler.

## Downloads

- Linux x86_64: tar.xz or AppImage
- Linux ARM64: tar.xz or AppImage
- macOS ARM64: DMG
- Windows x86_64: ZIP

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tompassarelli/gjoa/compare/v0.4.4...v0.4.5
